note: Election of the ten Larne Borough councillors, two for each of the five wards, May 1955 (statutory day 18 May 1955). Ten nominations were received for the ten seats, so there was no poll (Belfast News-Letter, 5 May 1955, p. 6); the Larne Times of 5 May 1955, p. 11, names the nominees ward by ward. The only change was in Gardenmore, where T. D. McKeever replaced W. A. McFaull. The paper prints the Inver member as 'Mr. W. J. Sandford'. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
